pagerduty-bot: ALERT - P0: api.redwood.internal - elevated 5xx rate (embeddings/generate) detected across eu-west-1. metric spike at 11:12 UTC. paging alice (oncall)

alice (oncall): I’m on it. seeing increased queue depth on runtime-gpu-pool-3, saturation on embeddings workers. ETA 2m to triage.

ben (eng-runtime): any recent deploys to embeddings or batching?

carla (sre): no deploys. autoscaler showing nodes healthy but request latencies climbing, backpressure kicking in (queue length > 1200).

alice (oncall): customer-impact: support reported multiple customers seeing 502/504s and timeouts. eva, frank can you confirm which orgs?

eva (support): frank: org-321 and org-777 reported failures around 11:10-11:14 UTC. they call out long running embedding jobs, huge batch size.

frank (customer-ops): org-777 is running a nightly bulk embed job unexpectedly. we asked them to pause but haven't heard back.

ben (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) apply route-level rate limiting to embeddings/generate 2) reduce max_in_flight on GPU workers from 128 -> 48 3) enable shedding for requests with queued_time > 15s 4) reduce request timeout from 120s -> 30s. Which orders do we want?

alice (oncall): prioritize low-risk actions first. Apply route rate-limit and per-org quota tweak for org-777 and org-321. Then reduce max_in_flight if queues still high.

carla (sre): I’ll push the global route rate limit: embeddings/generate -> 60 rps (was unbounded).

carla (sre): executing: 
```
PATCH /config/routes/embeddings/generate
{ "rate_limit_rps": 60 }
```

pagerduty-bot: Deploy job queued: config-change-789 by carla.

carla (sre): rate limit applied. monitoring now. queue depth dropped slightly but still > 800 on gpu-pool-3.

frank (customer-ops): org-777 agreed to pause the bulk job (they acknowledged at 11:18). org-321 still active, sent message to pause.

eva (support): org-321 paused. thanks.

alice (oncall): good catch. still seeing some persistent long tail. Ben, please prepare to reduce max_in_flight. Also add shedding rule for queued_time > 15s to return 429 with retry-after.

ben (eng-runtime): prepared. reducing max_in_flight on runtime nodes could increase latency for surviving requests but will lower concurrent memory pressure. executing staged change to gpu-pool-3: 128 -> 48.

ben (eng-runtime): command: 
```
POST /infra/pools/gpu-pool-3/patch
{ "max_in_flight": 48, "graceful_restart": true }
```

pagerduty-bot: infra change started by ben.

carla (sre): adding shedding policy now: 
```
PATCH /config/runtime/shedding
{ "condition": "queued_time_ms > 15000", "response": { "status": 429, "retry_after": 30 } }
```

carla (sre): shedding policy active. we'll map 429s to a customer-visible retry after message.

alice (oncall): also temporarily disable heavy reranker plugin on embeddings pipeline (route-level feature flag) to avoid extra CPU. Ben, flip the flag on runtime router for embeddings.

ben (eng-runtime): disabling reranker plugin for embeddings/generate: 
```
POST /config/featureflags
{ "route": "embeddings/generate", "flag": "reranker", "enabled": false }
```

ben (eng-runtime): change applied.

carla (sre): within 90s of these changes we see queue depth drop from ~1200 -> ~250 on gpu-pool-3. 5xx rate decreased ~85%. good signal.

alice (oncall): customer impact update: frank/eva confirm org-321 and org-777 seeing normal responses now?
\
frank (customer-ops): org-777 ok, org-321 reporting reduced error rate but still occasional 429s (expected).

eva (support): notified top 5 affected customers with status note and workaround (pause bulk jobs / retry backoff).

alice (oncall): follow-ups: 1) we should create an automated per-org backpressure rule to throttle bulk embedding jobs (e.g., any client doing > 5000 items/hour gets auto-quota) 2) add alert for queue-length per-pool > 300 3) review greedy batcher config that allowed huge batches from SDK. Ben/carla own items 1 & 2, Ben to own 3.

ben (eng-runtime): noted. will open PRs for batcher caps and per-org throttling policy. linking runbook: <https://runbook.internal/redwood/embedding-backpressure>

carla (sre): created alert ticket: ALERT-emb-queue-high. setting threshold at 300 and 5min window.

alice (oncall): final checklist before handoff to next oncall in 30m: document mitigations applied, keep shedding + rate-limit for 1h, watch queue depth and 5xx. I'll add post-incident notes.

ben (eng-runtime): also recommend tuning long request timeout back from 120s -> 60s globally as medium-term; haven't changed that yet.

alice (oncall): agreed. leaving notes for follow-up. handing off to dinesh for overnight watch in 30m. dinesh can you take over?

dinesh (platform): I’ll take it. will keep 15m checks and escalate if queue > 200 again.

pagerduty-bot: incident acknowledged by dinesh.

alice (oncall): thanks team. closing the P0 paging for now; moving to postmortem and follow-up tasks.

carla (sre): quick postmortem bullet: root cause: unthrottled bulk job combined with greedy client-side batching; mitigations: temporary route rate-limiting, per-org quota adjustments, reduce max_in_flight, enable shedding, disable reranker plugin, customer coordination.

frank (customer-ops): I'll coordinate customer comms and follow-ups for org-777 and org-321 with suggested SDK guidance to avoid huge batches.

alice (oncall): thanks all. I'll file the incident ticket and assign action items.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P0 -> transitioned to P1 monitoring.
